title: Steam platform
summary: The process's connection to Steam behind a pure C header: start with an optional restart through Steam, a per-frame pump with manual callback dispatch, typed events the game pulls, stop. Builds without the Steamworks SDK and runs without a Steam client, both as silent solo.
dependencies: Steamworks SDK through STEAMWORKS_SDK_DIR (optional, outside git; only redistributable_bin ships)
provides: steam_platform_start / steam_platform_stop / steam_platform_ready: one connection per process, statuses READY, NO_SDK, NO_CLIENT, RESTARTING, FAILED
steam_platform_run_frame / steam_platform_next_event: manual dispatch into a fixed event queue (OVERLAY)
steam_platform_deploy(<target> [APP_ID <id>]): the runtime library beside an executable, a development steam_appid.txt with APP_ID, its removal without
src/steam_platform_internal.h: raw callbacks by id, awaited and cancelled call results, counters and test hooks for the feature's own targets
